Text: I studied with Sara at the University of Tulsa College of Law. She was an excellent student, and one of the top students in our class.  She was consistently on target with her legal analysis and served as an example to other students.  Her study habits were admirable and she was a pleasure to work with at school.

Sara is the type of self-motivated, intelligent, employee that is invaluable. Sara was responsible to provide quality customer service to the students and staff at a satellite campus. She was given full responsibility to provide customer service to all students, faculty, and staff, including all PC repair and staffing of all ITV/DE courses.  Sara efficiently managed our other employees, including scheduling, training, and mentoring. Her diligence, attention to detail, work ethic, honesty, and loyalty were invaluable to our department. With her combination of soft and hard skills, I can highly recommend Sara for any position in any company.
Sara was an excellent student.  She is very bright and is a hard worker. She will be an asset to the Bar and a valuable addition to any law firm.
